installConfigs.instructions: Replace <your-notion-integration-token> with a Notion internal integration token. Create one at https://www.notion.so/profile/integrations — click 'New integration', name it, select the workspace, and copy the token (starts with 'ntn_'). Then share the pages or databases you want to access with the integration. Provides 22 tools for managing Notion pages, databases, comments, and search.
